8:41.text: And know that whatever of war-booty that you may gain, verily one-fifth
of it is assigned to Allâh, and to the Messenger, and to the near relatives
[of the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)]
and the wayfarer, if you have believed in Allâh and in that which We sent down to Our slave
, the Day when the two forces met
; And Allâh is able to do all things.

8:42.text: were on the near side of the valley, and they on the farther side, and the caravan on the ground lower than you. Even if you had made a mutual appointment to meet, you would certainly have failed in the appointment, but
that Allâh might accomplish a matter already ordained
, so that those who were to be destroyed
might be destroyed after a clear evidence, and those who were to live
might live after a clear evidence. And surely, Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

8:43.text: when Allâh showed them to you as few in your
dream; if He had shown them to you as many, you would surely have been discouraged, and you would surely have disputed in making a decision. But Allâh saved
. Certainly, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts.

8:44.text: (the army of the disbelievers on the Day of the battle of Badr)
, He showed them to you as few in your eyes and He made you appear as few in their eyes, so that Allâh might accomplish a matter already ordained
, and to Allâh return all matters

8:45.text: O you who believe! When you meet
force, take a firm stand against them and remember the Name of Allâh much
, so that you may be successful.
